messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "can cause premature birth"
set: ["can cause premature birth", "can cause premature birth or low birth weight", "premature birth", "can cause low birth weight", "can harm an unborn baby or cause birth defects", "can cause death", "uncontrolled asthma may increase risk of premature birth", "premature babies", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain", "drugs that can cause serotonin syndrome", "opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms", "newborn or premature baby", "can cause serious and life-threatening irregular heartbeat", "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "misuse can cause addiction, overdose, or death", "too much thyroid hormone can cause angina"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
